changelog_es: controlled HTTPS migration recognizes early VoxyWatch proxies
The installer now recognizes the exact legacy VoxyWatch Caddy shape used by early/demo installations (`host` plus loopback reverse proxy) even when it predates
Recognition is intentionally fail-closed: a different host, port or any additional directive remains unmanaged and is never overwritten.
This fixes controlled `legacy` to `public/internal` migrations without weakening protection for customer-owned Caddy configurations.
